card.name: The word toxic in warning headings
card.fires_on: The word toxic (or Toxic) at the start of adverse-reaction terms such as toxic megacolon, toxic epidermal necrolysis, toxic shock syndrome and toxicity. It also fires weakly on a few other word starts, like par in parathyroid.

modes.label: Toxic in condition names
modes.description: The word toxic opens a named condition in a warnings or contraindications list.
modes.example: Toxic colitis or<< toxic>> megacolon. Gastric retention

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: A few scattered starts of other words, such as par before athyroid.
